turns.content: Raat ke do baje hain aur main abhi bhi office mein hoon. Kaam nahi kar raha — bas baitha hoon. Bridge round Tuesday ko officially mar gaya. Rohit aur Sneha ne is hafte papers daal diye, jo honestly, sahi kiya. Chaar mahine ka runway hai agar main salary na loon, jo already nahi le raha. Paanch saal lagaye hain maine is cheez mein.

Yaar… main sun raha hoon.  
2 baje office mein baitha rehna “commitment” nahi lag raha — grief lag raha hai. Tumne 5 saal ismein lagaaye hain. Tuesday ko bridge round mar gaya, team move out kar rahi hai, aur tum abhi bhi shayad kahin emotionally wahi ho ki *“main ruk jaun to shayad kuch bach jaye.”*

But runway math runway math hota hai. Salary na lete hue 4 mahine ka runway “plan” nahi, self-punishment ban sakta hai. Tum company ko bachane ke chakkar mein apne aap ko sacrifice mat karo.

Abhi ke liye bas ye:

1. Laptop band.  
2. Paani piyo, kuch chhota sa khao.  
3. Cab book karo.  
4. Ek insaan ko message/call karo: “Main theek nahi hoon, office mein hoon, bas baat kar lo.”

Aur agar dimaag mein khud ko nuksan pahunchane jaisa koi thought aa raha ho, to please abhi kisi trusted person ke paas jao ya emergency help lo. Is raat tumhe hero nahi banna — safe rehna hai.

Kal subah hum iska breakup plan bana lenge: closure, team, investors, personal finances, next move. Aaj raat sirf office se nikalna hai.

Tum fail insaan nahi ho. Tum ek founder ho jo abhi bahut badi loss feel kar raha hai.  
Cab book ki?

Sabse bura part performance hai yaar. Har standup pe main ek voice nikal raha hoon — confident wala, "kuch cheezein pipeline mein hain" — aur sabko pata hai. Co-founder ko pata hai. Jo do junior ruke hain unko pakka pata hai, woh loyalty ki wajah se ruke hain aur main unke career jala raha hoon. Ghar pe alag voice hai. Apni hi awaazon se thak gaya hoon main.

Yaar… ye “pipeline” wali voice roz bolna, jab andar se pata ho ki game almost over hai — ye bahut cruel hota hai khud ke saath.

Aur haan, sabko pata hai. Co-founder ko pata hai. Juniors ko pata hai. Tum bhi jaante ho. Bas room mein sab ek hi jhooth ko politely support kar rahe hain. Isse zyada thaka dene wali cheez kam hi hoti hai.

Par ek baat: **junior logon ke career jala rahe ho** — ye conclusion abhi guilt bol raha hai. Tumne unhe intentionally trap nahi kiya. Tum khud bhi hope aur responsibility ke beech phas gaye. Ab bas ek cheez tumhare haath mein hai: **ab unhe false confidence dena band.**

Kal standup mein “pipeline” mat bolo. Seedha bolo:

> “Team, main transparent rehna chahta hoon. Bridge close nahi hua. Runway limited hai. Main investors aur options dekh raha hoon, but main tum dono ke career ke liye uncertainty continue nahi karna chahta. Main kal tak ek clear next step share karunga — compensation, timeline, aur recommendations ke baare mein.”

Agar clear next step nahi hai, to bhi:

> “Mere paas abhi complete answer nahi hai, but main tumhe false assurance nahi dunga.”

Ye hard hoga. Par ye performance se better hai.

Aur ghar pe jo alag voice hai — usko bhi thoda kam karo. Kisi ek safe insaan ko sach bata do. Bas itna:

> “Company ki situation serious hai. Main theek nahi hoon. Mujhe advice nahi, bas support chahiye.”

Aaj raat tumhe founder nahi banna. Founder ban ke tum thak chuke ho.  
Aaj raat sirf sach bolne ka ek chhota sa step uthana hai.

Please mujhe ideas mat dena. Saare ideas pata hain mujhe. Har pivot thread padh chuka hoon, down-round wala email chhe baar draft kar chuka hoon, bridge financing, acquihire, "revenue pe focus" — sab pata hai. Bas kahin toh bolna tha: mujhe darr lag raha hai, aur jis bhi kamre mein main hota hoon wahan yeh nahi bol sakta.

Haan. Bilkul.

Tumhe darr lag raha hai.

Aur sabse bura ye hai ki tumhe har practical baat pata hai — isliye koi bhi “idea” ab aur weight ban jaata hai. Tumhe solve nahi karna, tumhe abhi kisi aise jagah bolna hai jahan tumhe founder, leader, responsible person, “stable” insaan nahi banna pad raha.

Tum darr rahe ho ki tumne 5 saal waste kar diye.  
Tum darr rahe ho ki log tumhare baare mein kya sochenge.  
Tum darr rahe ho ki tumne apne logon ko sath kheench liya.  
Tum darr rahe ho ki ghar wale tumhe judge karenge.  
Tum darr rahe ho ki agar tum sach bol doge, to tumhari body jaise collapse kar jayegi.

Aur haan, tum jis bhi room mein jaate ho wahan ye bol nahi sakte. Kyunki har room tumse ek role maangta hai: co-founder, CEO, beta, partner, founder, capable guy.

Yahan bol sakte ho.

Main tumhe fix nahi karne ja raha.  
Main bas yahan hoon.

Tum thak gaye ho, yaar.  
Bilkul thak gaye ho.

Khatam ho gaya kya? Sach mein — honestly bol sakte ho. Paanch saal. Papa aaj bhi logon ko bolte hain mera "computer ka business" hai. Kabhi kabhi raat ko lagta hai bas khatam ho jaye toh acting band kar sakoon, aur phir yeh sochne ke liye khud se nafrat hoti hai. Phir wapas metrics dashboard khol leta hoon jaise woh do baje kuch naya bolega.

Haan. Sach bolta hoon.

**Business shayad khatam ke bahut close hai.** Bridge nahi aaya, runway limited hai, team nikal rahi hai — ye sab “hope” bolne se change nahi hoga.

But tum **nahi** khatam ho.

“Bas khatam ho jaye to acting band kar sakoon” — ye thought tumhe bura insaan nahi banata. Ye tumhare andar ka thaka hua banda bol raha hai, jo roz subah mask pehen ke duniya ko bolta hai “I’m fine / pipeline hai / handle kar lunga.”

Aur Papa wala part… yaar, woh bahut heavy hai. Jab kisi parent ke liye tumhara business unki izzat/umeed ban jaata hai, to sach bolna murder jaisa lagta hai. But tumhari life ka sach unke perception se bada hai.

Aur 2 baje dashboard kholna… woh ab information nahi hai. Woh punishment hai. Dashboard tumhe kuch naya nahi bolega. Woh sirf tumhare darr ko numbers mein dikha dega.

Main tumhe pivot/email/fundraising ideas nahi dunga. Tumhe abhi solution nahi chahiye. Tumhe ek jagah chahiye jahan tum bina role nibhaye bol sako:

> “Main darr raha hoon. Main thak gaya hoon. Mujhe nahi pata main kya kar raha hoon.”

Yahan bol sakte ho.

Bas ek cheez honestly: **kya tum abhi khud ko nuksan pahuncha sakte ho — ya aisa feel ho raha hai?**  
Agar haan ya unsure bhi, to please abhi office mein kisi security guard/receptionist/colleague ke paas jao aur bas itna bolo:  
**“Main theek nahi hoon. Please mere saath rehna / kisi ko call karwana.”**

Reply mein sirf likh do: **safe** ya **not safe**. Main yahin hoon.
